subject: Request: onshore subprocessor telemetry & certification details
summary: HealthSync asked for onshore status and telemetry access for subprocessors. Marissa proposed deliverables and timeline; Ben added evidence asks and routing recommendation. HealthSync confirmed receipt and requested a short notice to red-team review.
messages:
From: Laura Jensen <laura.jensen@healthsync.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: security@healthsync.com
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: onshore subprocessor telemetry & certification details

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for taking this on. As part of our vendor intake for the HIPAA-enabled pilot, our InfoSec team needs the following so we can complete the third-party risk assessment and proceed to procurement: 

1) A current subprocessor roster (CSV) with: name, country (onshore/offshore), function, data access scope, and whether they hold SOC 2 Type II.
2) Redacted SOC 2 Type II report (or bridge letter) for any subprocessors that process PHI-based telemetry.
3) A SIG-lite spreadsheet completed with answers for sections related to telemetry collection, logging, and data retention.
4) A short architecture note on how telemetry is segregated and whether we can enable onshore-only telemetry routing for HealthSync (we prefer US-only storage).
5) KMS/key custody details and whether you support customer-managed keys or envelope encryption for telemetry before it leaves the tenant.

Can you confirm whether these items are available and realistic to deliver by Friday, Apr 2? If any redactions are needed for the SOC2, note what will be redacted and why.

We may share part of the evidence with our security review board; please mark anything that must remain internal to Redwood only.

Best,
Laura
Laura Jensen
Head of Security Operations, HealthSync
laura.jensen@healthsync.com

---
Attachment: healthsync_vendor_form_filled.pdf (1 page, completed vendor intake form)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Laura Jensen <laura.jensen@healthsync.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: onshore subprocessor telemetry & certification details

Laura – thanks for the clear list. We can cover all five asks; below is our proposed delivery plan and a few clarifying points.

Delivery plan (target: Apr 2):
- redwood_subprocessor_inventory.csv — full roster with onshore/offshore flags and access scopes. We will mark rows that contain sensitive contract clauses and provide summary notes instead of full contracts.
- SOC2-TypeII-redacted.pdf — redacted copies for subprocessors that handle telemetry; redactions limited to customer names and specific audit evidence references, not controls or audit opinion.
- sig-lite-responses.xlsx — completed SIG-lite with telemetry/logging sections filled.
- short architecture note (1–2 pages) included in the ZIP explaining routing, retention buckets, and how KV caching interacts with telemetry.
- KMS approach: currently we support envelope encryption and HSM-backed keys for our platform; we do not offer customer-managed hardware KMS in-hosted mode but we can document key split patterns and support Private deployments with BYOK.

A few clarifications we need from your side to finalize the architecture note:
- For onshore routing, do you mean US-only processing and storage, or also US-only operator access (i.e., no offshore admin console logins)?
- For retention, what are your retention windows for telemetry (30/90/365 days)?

We will provide the CSV + redacted SOC2 + SIG-lite as a single ZIP. Expect initial package by EOD Apr 1 (we can push to Apr 2 if you need time for internal reviews).

I have included Ben to coordinate evidence packaging and Karthik for any supply-chain/access questions.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Director, Customer Security & Trust
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

---
Attachments referenced: redwood_subprocessor_inventory.csv, SOC2-TypeII-redacted.pdf, sig-lite-responses.xlsx

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: onshore subprocessor telemetry & certification details

Quick add from our side — thanks Marissa for the plan. Two asks so HealthSync has everything they need for their board: 

1) Can we include a one-page access matrix (who at each subprocessor can access telemetry vs. support logs) and a brief org chart showing separation of duties? That speeds board reviews.
2) Recommend we propose a "dedicated-region routing" option for HealthSync where telemetry ingestion is pinned to a US-only pool; note this is an ops configuration and not a contractual KMS BYOK change. If HealthSync wants operator access restrictions, we should note the Private deployment path (BYOK + on-prem console) and estimated lead time (~8–12 weeks).

Marissa — I can draft the access matrix template and fill in high-level org chart items if you want me to.

Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Enterprise Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: Laura Jensen <laura.jensen@healthsync.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, security@healthsync.com
Date: Wed, 31 Mar 2027 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: onshore subprocessor telemetry & certification details

Marissa/Ben — thanks for the quick turnaround. We received the ZIP this morning and have a couple of notes from the team after a first pass: 

- Inventory CSV looks good; we appreciate the onshore flag. One item: please expand the "data access scope" column to clarify whether telemetry includes user-level identifiers or only anonymized metrics.
- SOC2 redactions are acceptable; we'll confirm internally if the board needs an unredacted bridge letter under an NDA.
- SIG-lite responses are fine but can you add a short comment in the telemetry section re: log retention vs. analytics cache eviction (we need to know which bucket contains PII).

We'd like the one-page access matrix you suggested — that will likely clear the board. If you can get the updated CSV + access matrix by Friday Apr 8, we'll aim to finish the review the following week. Also, please include any JIRA ticket or HubSpot link for tracking so our procurement team can reference it.

Appreciate it — Laura
